translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

book.name: ROOMMA
book.title: ROOMMA Pauroofa Roomma maqannaA akaranimaqoo ufafa.

content: Pauroofa Isaraee maqannaasara qimudaoo qidanoo naiki raqeenoo qimanimu ufafa.

Qinee Pauroosa anoona ufa kai qimannimidaqa. Qinee asauku mundiranaindi maridaqa sia unna ufa qimarunausa maridaqa. Qini daakirafa Anutuna naaquqara andeeqara maraquna fannoo mifa rakisimarifaqa sia qinee unna ufa qianaura. Qinee qeeqa maqannaasa Isaraee maqannaara qimannimianaura.
Misara firaaqoo qimuqusimarifaqa qikiraqaidaqa qeeqa maqannaasa qeeqa moodaa qimaqi moodaa fidika rainarausara miqidaqa. Misa Yisunara sia fee qimasee arunara oonumafi iriqa ikiraqaidaqa.

Misa Isaraee maqannaasa asauku mundiranasaaqaraana rakeemmiqa maridaqa. Anutuna narira ufa ameemaanai marianara qinee rakeemaseeqa minni misa nimaaqa maqaanaqa misa aiqaree asauku mundiranasaa atooqafiqa naaru kaqi mariranaki mariaqaana.

Misa Isaraee maqannaasa Anutufa aiqama maqannaasakinaana rusandeesamumandee Isaraee maqannaa maroosa mariafanoo, Anutufa misa mareeqeenoo narí faiqinamukamasee narí areenarana raina nimiqoosa mariafanoo. Anutufa narí moodaanaki kira ufa oosana oosana moomoo nimiseenoo narí sandufa faqa Mooseenasaa quqasoona faqa niminau, misa Anutuna amooqirafa anoonamau fimariasa, misa Anutuna qima afeekaikira ufa moomoo maree marusa.

Misa ooqeenaasa faiqí nuqufaqaasa Abarahaamana faqa Isakeena faqa Yakooboona faqa misauqa faiqi namu niku nisauku mariasa, misa asauku mundirafa mi maqannaasaki qumu kambiqafufaqa moodaa maqannaa marusa maridaqa. Anutufa aiqamausara rakisidanoo, naaru naaru mina amooqiaqa. Kuqaa.
Qinee Isaraee maqannaasara irisee sia Anutuna qima afeekaikira ufara kadiqee maqi qidaqa. Anutufa sia aiqama Isaraee maqannaasa rusandeesamumandee narí faiqi namu mariaqee qimasee maranau.

Abarahaamana aiku asauku atiuqa faqa sia aiqama Anutuna aiku asaukukiqau. Minara qidaqa, Anutufa maaqi qimasee Abarahaamana qimaminau. Ani faiqi namukinaana Isakeena aiku asauku kai ani aiku asauku fee qianaura.

Mi ufana Anutuna qimamira ufara qinee maaqi qidaqa. Abarahaamana dapi anaasee Qakaarana kaqi fifau maroona faiqi namu sia Abarahaamana aiku asauku fee qinoo maridanoo. Anutufa qima afeekaikiranannai maqoo faiqina mina aiku asaukuara Abarahaamana aiku asauku anoona uqannee qidaqa.
Anutuna qima afeekaikira ufa maaqimminoo marinau. Qinee qeeqa andeeqara aukuana aniree Saraqana dadaaqiananoo faiqi maqaannoo.
Sia mifa kai, maana faqa Reebeekanara faqa qimannimianaura, Reebeekafa qaara faiqifaqaafa marinau, miqanda nikoofa maasa qikeeku qikaaku Isakeefa marinau.

Reebeekafa faiqi maqaaninnaqanda mi faiqiqanda nuqu indaaruqaa faiqi auqu Eesaufa mariannoo fee qinau. Mina innaaqianna maqaaninna faiqina auqu Yakooboonee qinau. Miqanda sia kambiqaraqoo Anutufa indaaruqaa faiqiara innaaqianaa faiqi mina ainainamma aisaaninna fee qimasee afaaqooqa qinau. Sia miqanda kambiqaqa maridaqau mandoosana fee amiqira oosana fee maraidammiafoo qimaseenoofau mi ufana quqanau. Anutufa moodaa maroo oosanafa Anutufa miqandara afaaqooqa quna sia nariqaqara oosanasaarau afaaqooqa qinau, narí irirana aidiranasaa munduanifeera indaaruqaafa Eesaufa quandaki innaaqianaana mina ainaina maisaannoo fee qinau.
Ooqeenaa akarakinaa ufa maaqimminoo minara maridanoo.

content.text: Qinee Yakooboonara dididanoo Eesaunara qikooqaidanoo fee qinau.

content: Miqandara irisee Anutunara naqi fee qianauree Anutunara sia andeeqee maqi qianauree. Oo sia uqanna miqi qianaura andeeqanoo marifa Anutufa maaqi qimasee Mooseena qimaminau.

content.text: Qinee qeeqa iriranannai kai faiqí anaasee akaqausa narusee akaqausa nifauaanaura, qeeqa iriranannai kai

content: Minara aiqama ainaina sia faiqí nidiranasaa mundinoo maridanoo Anutuna amuqusiranasaa mundinoo maridanoo.
Ooqeenaa akaraki Mooseefa Faraoona maaqi qimasee qimaminau.

content.text: Qinee Anutusa ani Faraoona mareeqee Isipa maqannaa karaambaiqai kianneera quqaqiafana, qinee Anutusa ani Faraoofa qini ufa rukioonara ani kuqaruanaura. Minannai qinee qeeqa afeeka faqa qeeqa duqu faqa aiqama maqa maaqa afaaqasasa mariasa iriaqee qimasee ani quqaqiafana.

content: Doo maqee maasa mi ufana iriseeqa Anutunara maaqi qidaqa. Anutufa narí kai irisee akaqausara amuqusifanoo amiqi amiqimmidanoo kafaa Anutufa narí kai iriseenoo akaqausa ufa rukiara oosana nimidanoo.
Anutufa maqa qafeera foora maasa auquqisanau.

Innee mina iriseeqa quandaki maaqi qimasee aaqamasee qini qimaqimifaranoo. Ani ufa miqinoo marinaqa maasa mandoosana maraananoo naqimasee Anutufa maasara aaqee mariasee qiannoo fee. Naqimasee maasa Anutufa auquqisoo mandoosanara iriseeqa rakeemaki amiqira oosanamau fuanauree.

Qinee mina iriseeqa maaqi qimasee ani qimamianaura, Anutufa aniara aaqee mariaanoo qimasee afairirana anee yafee maridanee quandaki narí qimaminnaree anee kaqikaafa mariananoo. Qafee auqiranara iria. Faiqí moo fannoo maqa maraseenoo qafee auqimarifanoo mi qafeefa sia quandakinoo mi fasiqanara aqidanoo anee nanaree qini maaqimmasee auqidanee, sia qafee fannoo miqi qidanoo.

Mi fasiqafa qafee auqimarifa narí iriranannai kai maqa qumaree turi iseenoo atakuseenoo mi maqana rainasee akaqana qumareenoo narí iriranannai kai amiqirana akara rirana auqidanoo kafaa mina dinni ati quqaqoona raina qumareenoo narí iriranannai kai moo kaqi dapi qafee kai auqidanoo.

Anutufa miqikai maseenoo maasa auquqimaqanau. Maasaki akaqausa manda qafeera foora maasa akaqausa auquqimaqaseenoo idaki fifandinausee qidanoo. Sia aaqee kai minara naruannoo naaru kasooqaqee mina akiaqara naruannoo. Kisaaqasaa narí aanoo irana rafaaqafusee mari inanoo naaru naruannoo. Miqoo narí aanoonnai faqa narí afeekannai faqa miqoo mandoosana maree mariasa kuridi nimaqaannoo.

Kafaa mina dinni amiqira qafeera foora kasooqaqee maasa mina kaaqa areenarana mareefandinausa akaqausa auquqisanau, mina amuqusa maasa ubeekanoo marisa maasasaa kai mina idaaqira moomoo areenarafa kooroo ianifeera maasasaa nammariara foora narí areenarana adiannimaqanau.
Doo maasa daaree mariasa doo misa kai doo maa maridaqa sia Yuda maqannaasakiqari kaifau, aanaamurukiqari faqa Anutufa daaree marisa maridaqa.
Ooqai tamummaqara fasiqa moo auqu Qooseeaafa mifa minara maaqi qimaqoofa.

content.text: Sia qeeqa maqannaasa naarama quqasee qini faiqi anaasee fee qianaura. Qini qikooqeemari maqannaasara qinee quandaki misara qini didimariasee qianaura.
Akaqausara innee sia qini faiqi namu fee qimaria maqusakinaasa doo qimaria maqusanaasara kai misara kaqi marira Anutuna faiqi namu fee qifaranoo.

content: Doo Qooseeaana ufa miqinoo maridanoo.
Isaiaafa Isaraee maqannaara maaqi qimasee akara rinau.

content.text: Isaraee maqannaasa nukuda moomoora foora iqa mariafanoo misakinaana Anutufa oodaa kai mareeqeenoo asumu mariranaki quqaannoo.

Mi aukuanna mikari Anutufa dauni dauni mandainaina akiaqara marasee aiqama maqannaasa minannai naruannoo Anutufa faiqí aanaaseera kisaaqasaa nifeesida mariranasaa doo taikeefoo qimasee aiqamausa tautumasee naruannoo. Minara Isaraee maqannaasa oodaa kai Anutuna saqarikamandainanoo oodaa kai asumu mariranaki mara quqaannoo.

content: Isaiaafa kafaa Isaraee maqannaara maaqi qimasee akara rinau.

content.text: Karaambaiqa uriqararafa sia maasa ati oodaa mara quqasainanoofau Soodooma maqusa faqa Koomoora
maqusa faqa naanna ramaseenoofau aiqama taikasani, daridanoo oodaa mafi quqasoosa qaaramoo maridaqa.

content: Isaraee maqannaasa Yisunasaa faandi ooniara maqi farindamaki aqu fiqau.

Doo minara maasa naqi fee qianauree. Maana kai qianaura. Anaamuru mariasa sia Anutuna afusaa andeeqaranaki keeqararee qidaqa sia amani mariasa doo misa narí irirana Yisunasaa rusisee minannai mina andeeqaranaki keeqafi maridaqa.

Misa miqiqa marifanoo Anutufa rusandeesamumasee maroo fasiqanaaseesa Isaraee maqannaasaa misa Mooseena sandufakiaqa randasee mi iriranannai Anutuna andeeqaranaki fuanauree qidaqa aana sia minaki marinara sia irirai munari minaridaqa aaqamaki kaqi runnambiqau.

Naqi fee mandee sia paquriqau. Misa Anutufinnai firana nári kadaapiriranasaa kai mundinoo maridanoo sia saqarikirafa minasaa mundinoo maridanoo. Misa anoona aana Yisunamau fimarianara qaoo qimasee Yisunara oonisaara foora niku amaki saamuriqau.
Ooqeenaa tamummaqara fasiqa akarauqa mi ooninara maaqi qiqau.

content.text: Qinee Anutusa mi oonina Sioona maqusai quqaqaanaqa faiqí anaasee mi ooninasaa niku rupaurifaranoo. Faandi ooni miqirana qinee mi oonina quqasaanaqa minasaa farindamaki saamurifaranoo. Moo fannoo narí irirana minasaa rusiqainafa sia kadooparaannoo.

content: Tamummaqarausa Yisunara miqimmasee ooqai akara riqau.
